description: This file defines the NoteRepository class, which manages CRUD operations and searches for notes stored in an SQLite database within an Android application. It interfaces with a DBHelper class and operates on Note model instances.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing high-level CRUD and search operations for notes stored in an SQLite database within an Android app.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by most recently updated first.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Returns notes where title or content match the query (case-insensitive).

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a single note by ID or null if not found.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID. Returns true if a row was updated.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID. Returns true if a row was deleted.

methods.name: readNotesFromCursor
methods.description: Utility function that reads a list of Note objects from a Cursor.

methods.name: readNote
methods.description: Utility function that reads a single Note object from the current position of a Cursor.
